description: This file contains TypeScript code defining types, state management functions, and async actions related to skills management, including searching, loading details, installing, and updating skills via a client interface.

methods.name: setSkillMessage
methods.description: Sets or deletes a skill message in the state.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error into a string message.

methods.name: setClawHubSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and resets related state.

methods.name: loadSkills
methods.description: Loads the skills report from the client, handling loading state and errors.

methods.name: updateSkillEdit
methods.description: Updates the skill edits record with a new value.

methods.name: updateSkillEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill via client request and updates state.

methods.name: saveSkillApiKey
methods.description: Saves the API key for a skill via client request.

methods.name: installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill by requesting the client and reloads skills.

methods.name: searchClawHub
methods.description: Performs a search on ClawHub and updates results or errors.

methods.name: loadClawHubDetail
methods.description: Loads detailed info for a specific ClawHub skill.

methods.name: installFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill from ClawHub by slug.
